title: Reveal top rune of rune deck then recycle it does not happen
expected: Card def (twisted-fate-gambler.ts:22-31) models the reveal as {type:"look", from:"rune-deck"} + {type:"recycle", from:"board", target:{type:"rune"}}. Both are no-ops in the engine: (1) look.ts:23-28 only maps "deck"->"mainDeck" and otherwise passes `from` verbatim; the engine zone is "runeDeck" (setup.ts:265, resources.ts:57) and no "rune-deck" alias exists anywhere in riftbound-engine/src, so getCardsInZone("rune-deck") yields nothing, topN is empty and the handler returns at look.ts:28 without setting any reveal pendingChoice. (2) recycle.ts:59-61 returns early unless target is self/unit/gear (comment at :53 explicitly says rune recycles are not handled), and :75-77 additionally skips rune cardType. So no reveal, no recycle, rune deck order unchanged — matches observation.
observed: Across 4 runs the rune deck order was byte-identical before and after the trigger fully resolved (e.g. top '10-ogn-166' stayed on top, bottom unchanged), no reveal log entry or reveal UI; card def models this as look(rune-deck)+recycle(target rune from board) and neither has any observable effect
